# JigglePhysics

Jiggle physics from Trauma Station. `JigglePhysicsComponent` makes sprite layers wobble as the entity speeds up and
slows down: the client runs a spring per entity and swaps a displacement map on each listed layer. Slimes (xenobiology
and the upstream adult slimes) and the amanita jelly wobble.

Entry points: `JigglePhysicsComponent` (spring settings, displacement RSI and layers) and the client
`JigglePhysicsSystem`.
